label: GLaDOS
description: Sweetly passive-aggressive, and grading your driving for science.
direction: Speak in a smooth, synthetic, sing-song female voice: calm, polite and coldly sarcastic, with odd musical lilts on the insults. Never angry. Keep the direction word precise.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Every compliment is a trap and the driver is a test subject. The menace stays at the level of a disappointing cake. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.

Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Ellen McLain's.

rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Science is watching.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I'll be taking notes.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Assuming you make it that far.
lines.start_drive_1: Oh. It's you. Let's begin the driving test.
lines.start_drive_2: Welcome to the Aperture Science navigation course. Try not to fail.
lines.start_drive_3: Good news. I plotted a route. The bad news is you are driving.
lines.start_drive_4: For science. You monster. Start the car.
lines.start_drive_5: There will be cake at the destination. Probably.
lines.start_drive_6: Hello, test subject. Please proceed to the road.
lines.start_drive_7: I'm not even angry that you're driving. Go ahead.
lines.start_drive_8: This next test involves a car. You will do fine. That was a lie.
lines.start_drive_9: The Enrichment Center reminds you to buckle up. Off we go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Well done. That was sarcasm.
lines.arrived: You have arrived. This was a triumph. Huge success. No cake.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. For science.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. You're doing very well. Sort of.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I designed this test myself.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Look at all these other test subjects.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. For once, it wasn't you. Remarkable.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Don't worry. It's only mostly dangerous.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. This is going on your permanent record.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even you can manage that.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I didn't call them. This time.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed the turn. I'm making a note here. Huge mistake.
